Regulation: B.C. Reg. 121/2026
Made under: Public Sector Employers Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 10, 2026

B.C. Reg. 121/2026, deposited July 10, 2026, under thePUBLIC SECTOR EMPLOYERS ACT[section 15]. Order in Council 311/2026, approved and ordered July 10, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that (a)	the Health Care Employers Regulation, B.C. Reg. 427/94, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, and (b)	the Social Services Employers Regulation, B.C. Reg. 84/2003, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; A. DIX,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 2 of the Health Care Employers Regulation, B.C. Reg. 427/94, is amended (a)	by striking out the following: Beacon Community Services Society Morgan Place Holdings Ltd., and Turning Point Recovery Society. 1	Section 2 of the Social Services Employers Regulation, B.C. Reg. 84/2003, is amended (a)	by striking out the following: Connective Support Society Kamloops Cresteramics Society for the Handicapped Malaspina Community Resource Services Ltd. Société de les Enfants Michif, and Beaufort Association for Inclusion in Action Beyond Barriers Support Society Pathway Community Services Ltd.. minutes_briefs.title: BC removes five employers from health and social services labour regulations
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended two regulations that list which employers are covered by province-wide labour rules for health care and social services workers. The Health Care Employers Regulation and the Social Services Employers Regulation were updated to remove several organizations from their lists. This means those organizations are no longer considered 'public sector employers' under the Public Sector Employers Act, which sets out how unions and employers negotiate wages and working conditions. The change took effect when the regulation was deposited on July 10, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If your organization was removed from these regulations, confirm your new status with the BC Public Sector Employers' Council and review your collective bargaining obligations.
